pre_target_access_correction.reason: The original literal all-JSON-filename exclusion also collected historical fit/lineage declarations whose union covers all 5,600 organizer-train sources. Before any QAP fit/eval target was opened, it was corrected to exclude every actual/opened evaluation-panel field plus every frozen-input checkpoint lineage, while not treating historical train-only fit declarations as exact-panel access.

activation_prerequisite.parent_authorization: The Rank2 downstream decoder is explicitly authorized by the root task after the representation gate; the earlier fusion report itself remains local-only and is not retroactively edited.

distinction_from_failed_lines.socket_permutation_flow: Retains explicit directional pairwise tile-to-grid energy at every refinement; it never collapses the graph into separable row/column coordinate proposals.
distinction_from_failed_lines.historical_qap: Activated only after source-disjoint fullres-relation evidence exceeded the preregistered precision/correct-attachment knee; edge weights are learned with exact shuffles instead of applying a solver to the old weak score matrix.
distinction_from_failed_lines.historical_sync: No gauge-free relative pose claim: the fixed absolute grid and dirty-visible tile-to-slot unary are optimized jointly, and Hungarian fixes a strict absolute permutation.
distinction_from_failed_lines.standalone_sinkhorn: Sinkhorn is only a bounded continuous optimizer inside a sparse quadratic objective; it is not the solver objective by itself.
distinction_from_failed_lines.dense_affinity: Only O(E*N) sparse directional messages are materialized; no (N^2)^2 four-index affinity tensor.

selection.exclusion_policy: Before roster commitment, scan every existing JSON under configs and outputs. Exclude all explicit eval/evaluation/local/confirm/decoder/terminal/selection/selected/source panel filename fields and every singular source_filename/filename case record, but ignore broad train/fit/lineage/pool/library declarations as panel labels. From frozen binary checkpoints add only actual train/fit/eval rosters; do not confuse an exclusion pool or lineage registry with pixels actually opened. Write and hash selection_commitment.json before opening any selected target.

sparse_graph.selection_priority: target-free max raw/restored standardized evidence plus frozen relation rank/confidence and internal-component indicator
